message: Function arguments must use a_ prefix

evaluator_config.message_template: Function '{name}' arguments must use a_ prefix (except self/cls; CLI entry points exempt)

rationale: Consistent argument naming improves code readability and searchability. The a_ prefix distinguishes parameters from local variables at a glance. CLI entry points (Typer/Click @command/@callback/@group) are exempt: their parameter names are the public CLI surface (flags and positional args), not internal API parameters, so a_ would leak into help text and call sites.
remediation: Rename arguments: def func(a_name: str, a_count: int):. Do not apply a_ to Typer/Click command parameters; use plain names that match the CLI interface (task, query, output).

guidance.explanation: Internal functions use a_ on parameters (a_value, a_multiplier). CLI handlers decorated with @command / @callback / @group must use plain parameter names that mirror the CLI contract (task, query), not a_task. Built-ins self, cls, args, and kwargs remain exempt everywhere.
